name: new_v2_four_observed_axis_robustness_envelope_v2
aggregation: unweighted mean and minimum of four axis-specific pooled native-trial macro-F1 values; preserve each observed axis and the minimum subject/condition cell separately
selection: report all four arms and validation/final phases; do not select using final users or later descriptive ranking
boundary: Day and user use different splits of the same GRABMyo subset and are correlated, not independent populations. Force changes users as well as intensity; other datasets have different labels/rates/devices. Four-axis mean is descriptive and not pooled accuracy. Own-device posture, speed and real quality remain unobserved for this exact bank.
